Per rules SS15/SS17 (filter-only pages, own-URL requirement) these four facet views were NOT extracted as separate rows - only the one parent 'Festive Decor' PLP qualifies as a genuine own-URL category. Kept INCLUDED (not excluded) because it passes every other prong of the SS20 test (real PLP, real category not marketing, own URL, own qty+evidence, first-class node in the site's own Decor sub-nav) but flagged MANUAL REVIEW rather than assigned a confident single-holiday name. Homepage banners referencing 'Festive Ready Home' (/festive-ready-home/c/10581), 'Ritual Ready Essentials' (Ganesh Chaturthi-themed filtered decor link), and 'Bappa Bliss' (/bappa-bliss/c/65650) were checked and are marketing/campaign landing pages tied to homepage promo banners, not stable taxonomy nodes reachable from the category sitemap or the Decor sub-nav - excluded as marketing per SS4/SS17.
